titel: SPECIAL EPISODE Corbitt Wall - The Man Behind Feeder Flash & How Beaver Put Itself on the Map

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Corbett Wall discusses his cattle industry roots, market reporting, and DV Auction.
kurzfassung: Corbett Wall shares his family history in the cattle business, moving from traditional ranching and USDA market reporting to his current role with DV Auction. He reflects on his career path, the evolution of market data, and his long-standing relationship with the Beaver County Stockyards. The conversation highlights the growth of online cattle sales and the deep personal connections within the livestock industry.
stichpunkte: Corbett Wall was raised in the cattle trade, with family roots in building sale barns and running livestock across New Mexico and Colorado.
His great-granduncle's brothers performed in Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show.
He completed a USDA internship in market news, eventually reporting markets in the Deep South, Minnesota, and Pennsylvania.
He spent 15 years in Missouri managing state-level USDA market reporting for grain and livestock.
Frustrated by government constraints, he joined DV Auction to help translate vast amounts of transaction data into market reports.
The Feeder Flash daily show became an essential morning listen for ranchers, stalkers, and cattle feeders nationwide.
DV Auction expanded its broadcasting network from about 30 sale barns to nearly 200.
An accidental meeting in a parking lot sparked a close partnership between Wall and the Beaver County Stockyards.

clips.hook: Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show connection
clips.text: Two relatives grew tired of ranching and joined a famous traveling entertainment show where they rode horses and tossed wooden tokens for sharpshooting displays.

clips.hook: Working in northern stockyards and Amish country
clips.text: After gaining experience at various grain exchanges and stockyards, a new assignment led to reporting markets in an unfamiliar region surrounded by Pennsylvania Dutch communities.

clips.hook: The growth of online broadcasting in sale barns
clips.text: The company pioneered placing video cameras inside livestock auction facilities to stream proceedings on the internet, eventually scaling up the number of connected sale barns significantly.

clips.hook: Weighing a career choice against expert advice
clips.text: A veteran buyer offered blunt career advice about a proposed auctioneer job, explicitly warning that taking the position over a government salary would make someone a fool.

clips.hook: Massive growth in annual cattle sales
clips.text: Comparing past figures to current projections reveals that annual marketing volume has multiplied several times over, transforming a local operation into a major livestock hub.

beschreibung:
Corbitt Wall of DV Auction's Feeder Flash sits down with host Layne Konkel at Beaver County Stockyards in Beaver, OK — covering four generations of cattle trading roots, 18 years inside USDA Market News, and how a random Saturday stop in Beaver's parking lot turned into one of the most important partnerships in the barn's history.
